title: microbox WGS pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet passed to --input when --pipeline wgs. Deliberately minimal - one row per isolate, no patient/lane/tumor-normal columns (single-organism haploid isolate sequencing, not sarek-style clinical multi-lane human WGS). The reference genome is a single pipeline-wide params.wgs_reference_fasta, not a per-row column, since a WGS run is normally many isolates of the same organism against one reference (PLAN.md docs/planning/PLAN.md section 6.9). NOTE, same as the two existing metagenomics schemas (schema_input.json / schema_input_contigs.json): this file is documentation of the expected shape, not wired to a validation plugin anywhere in this repo yet (no nf-schema/nf-validation, no validateParameters() call) - flagged as an open follow-up, not silently assumed to be enforced.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'
